On Saturday evenings, Amy reviews the notes from class. At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The bridge is four centuries old.
The birthday party has become an important part of daily life. Amy is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. Amy thanked Owen for the honest advice. Best of all, the lights went out one by one.

Amy wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. There are always more possibilities than we expect. What's more, she is interested in ancient history.

Amy plans to study history harder this term. Owen advised Amy to try reading as a new hobby. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. We wandered through the bustling night market till midnight.
Little by little, things began to change. The picnic ground looked quieter than usual that evening. Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
